name: Flexcell
description: Uruguayan online store for phone accessories, chargers and PC accessories, with phone repair service. Ships home across Uruguay.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de accesorios para celulares, cargadores y accesorios para PC, con servicio técnico de celulares. Envía a domicilio a todo Uruguay.

ships_to.notes: Terms page says home delivery across Uruguay; interior orders ship from Tres Cruces with the carrier chosen by the buyer; same-day Montevideo delivery subject to stock and zone.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Site header mentions Retiro en Cordon; the terms page gives no pickup conditions.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Shipping cost is calculated at checkout.

sources.supports: Terms page: delivery across Uruguay, Montevideo same-day, interior 1 to 3 business days
Home page: accessories categories, add-to-cart, Retiro en Cordon mention
